    • createKeyProvider

      public static KeyProvider createKeyProvider(Configuration conf, String configKeyName) throws IOException
      Creates a new KeyProvider from the given Configuration and configuration key name.
      Parameters:
      conf - Configuration
      configKeyName - The configuration key name
      Returns:
      new KeyProvider, or null if no provider was found.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the KeyProvider is improperly specified in the Configuration
